footer.demo: BiletFlow is an academic project. Payments, refunds, identity checks and payouts are simulations: no real money moves and no card details are collected.

common.demoMoney: Demonstration amounts in KZT, not real transactions.

home.lead: Concerts, meetups and student events. Register for free events in a minute and keep every ticket in one place.
home.empty: No events match these filters. Try another city or category.

support.title: Support

support.subject: Subject

support.assigned: The request is assigned to you.
support.asyncHint: This is not a live chat. New replies appear here automatically.

auth.name: Full name

account.organizerYes: You can create events and issue tickets.
account.organizerNo: Create an organizer profile to publish your own events. It is free.

org.title: My events

empty.upcoming: No upcoming events. Create one: publishing and free tickets cost nothing.
empty.active: No event is running right now.
empty.completed: Finished events appear here with their orders, check-ins and history.

org.becomeLead: Create an organizer profile to publish events. Creating events and giving out free tickets is free; paid sales are activated per event.
org.identityText: Needed before selling paid tickets. In this academic version the check is a simulation and is approved at once.
org.payoutText: Where ticket revenue would be paid. Demonstration only: enter any value, only the last 4 characters are kept and no money is paid out.
org.accountHint: Do not enter a real account number.

eventForm.title: Event title
eventForm.imagesHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. The first image is the cover.
eventForm.timezoneHint: All dates below are in this time zone.
eventForm.regOpenHint: Empty = as soon as the event is published.

visibilityHint.unlisted: Not listed. Anyone with the link can open it.
visibilityHint.private: Not listed. Opens only with the invitation link.

eventForm.created: Draft created. Add ticket types next.
eventForm.useLayoutHint: A concert hall with VIP, Parterre and Balcony sections (152 seats), for assigned seating.

manage.suspended: A platform administrator suspended this event: {reason}

statusHelp.draft: This event is a draft. Only you can see it. Publish it when the details and ticket types are ready.
statusHelp.published: This event is published and attendees can register.
statusHelp.unpublished: This event is hidden and registration is paused. Tickets that were already issued stay valid.
statusHelp.cancelled: This event is cancelled. Its orders, tickets and history are kept for your records.

manage.paidInactive: This event has paid ticket types, but paid sales are not active yet. Finish the checklist:
manage.duplicated: Copy created as a draft. Check the dates.
manage.inCheckoutHint: Held for buyers who have not paid yet

manage.cancelReasonHint: Shown to attendees in the cancellation email.

tickets.lead: Each ticket type has its own price, quantity and sales period. Counters update as people check out.
tickets.empty: No ticket types yet. Add at least one before publishing.
tickets.name: Name
tickets.paidHint: Paid tickets can be bought only after paid sales are activated for this event.
tickets.seatedHint: With assigned seating the quantity equals the number of seats and is set on the Seat map tab.
tickets.hiddenLabel: Hide this ticket type from attendees

seating.general: This event uses general admission, so there is no seat map. To sell assigned seats, choose a venue with a seat map and switch seating to assigned seats.
seating.locked: Seats have already been reserved or sold, so the seat map can no longer be changed.
seating.needTypes: Create ticket types first: each section is sold at the price of one ticket type.
seating.pricesHint: Choose the ticket type sold in each section, or close the section.
seating.blockHint: Click a seat to take it off sale, for example for equipment or guests. Click again to release it.

orders.policyBlocks: The refund policy of this event does not allow a refund
orders.refundText: Refund order {number} of {name} in full: {amount}? This is a simulated refund. The tickets become invalid and return to sale.
orders.cancelText: Cancel free registration {number} of {name}? The tickets become invalid.
orders.refunded: Order refunded. The attendee was notified.
orders.cancelled: Registration cancelled. The attendee was notified.

promo.lead: A campaign gives a discount through a promo code and a special Campaign QR code that opens the event with the code applied. A Campaign QR code is not a ticket and never admits anyone.
promo.name: Campaign name
promo.qrAlt: Campaign QR code for promo code {code}
promo.qrText: Print it on posters and flyers. Scanning opens the event page with the discount applied. It is marked as not a ticket and the entrance scanner rejects it.

staff.lead: Event admins sign in to the BiletFlow Check-in mobile app with their own account and see only the events assigned to them.
staff.empty: Nobody is assigned yet. You can always check attendees in yourself.
staff.emailHint: The person needs a BiletFlow account with this email.

activation.lead: Free tickets always work. To sell paid tickets for this event, finish the five steps below. Activation applies to this event only.
activation.demo: Academic version: the identity check, the fee payment and payouts are simulations. No real money moves.
activation.active: Paid sales are active. Attendees can buy paid tickets.
activation.suspended: Paid sales were suspended by a platform administrator: {reason}
